title: OpenAI Wins $100M Replit AI Contract From Anthropic With Steep Price Cuts
summary:
OpenAI is offering steep pricing discounts to win the largest AI coding customers from its rival, Anthropic. Replit shifted most of its AI expenditures to OpenAI after being offered more than 30% off on a contract worth over $100M a year, a move that came after Anthropic refused to extend Replit's prior discount without a higher spending commitment.

The discounts have also shifted workloads at Rippling, where OpenAI's share of coding work grew from 16% in May to 52% while Anthropic's share fell from 57% to 18%. OpenAI also offered DataCamp a 40% discount to use Codex, a deal the company estimates could cut costs by 80% to 90%. These efforts to gain market share occur as OpenAI projects that its compute spending this year will exceed its revenue.
